records.heading: start here
records.text: ASM BOTS is a Core War arena for 8086 assembly. You write a bot of at most 512 bytes. The arena loads it into 64 KB of shared memory beside the other bots, and runs them all, one instruction at a time. The last bot with a live process wins. This page is a placeholder. The full docs arrive soon: Start here: the 60-second tour, and your first bot. The machine: memory, registers, flags, processes, cycles, and death. Language reference: every instruction, directive, and expression. Strategy guide: imps, dwarfs, stones, papers, scanners, and more. Tournaments and hills: formats, scoring, and ratings. Tools: the CLI, replays, share links, and the API. Changelog and ISA versions.

records.heading: The smallest bot
records.text: The imp copies the word it runs one word ahead, then runs into the copy, forever: Until the docs arrive, open the arena or write a bot. Press / to search the docs, and ? to see every key.
